dialogue.stage2: Mom says I can put my socks on by myself now!#$b#Look — left foot first.
dialogue.stage3: I watered three tomato plants today.#$b#Mom says you should walk around them, or you'll step on the seedlings.
dialogue.stage4: Miss Penny talked about the Stardrop today.#$b#Vincent kept sneaking snacks under the desk.
dialogue.stage5.dream: I think I want to be a farmer. Like you.#$b#But a farmer who reads books. Is that allowed?
dialogue.stage5.rebel: Everyone keeps telling me what to do.#$b#I want to go to the mines someday. Don't tell Mom.
dialogue.stage6.dream: I moved the kegs into the chest this morning.#$b#You rest. I've got the farm today.
dialogue.stage6.rebel: I sold the whole shipping bin. All of it.#$b#...You were going to sell it anyway, right?
dialogue.in_class: Shh — Miss Penny is talking.#$b#I'll show you my notes later.
scene.first_walk: Look at me! One step... two!#$b#I can walk now!
scene.first_walk.parent: He walked today. All the way across the room.#$b#I don't know why I'm crying about it.
scene.childhood: I'm a big kid now. Mom says big kids get their own cup.#$b#I picked the blue one.
scene.childhood.parent: He's not a baby any more.#$b#...I'm fine. I'm fine.
scene.first_school: Miss Penny has a desk for me. A real one, with my name on it.#$b#Do I have to go every day?
scene.first_school.parent: It's only three mornings a week, and it's ten minutes away.#$b#And I'm still going to worry.
scene.dream: I had a dream about the farm last night.#$b#I was the one waking up early, not you.
scene.dream.parent: He told me he wants to be like you.#$b#Try not to let that go to your head.
scene.adulthood: I'm grown up now. I'll stay here, on the farm, with you two.#$b#And I'll do my share. That's how it works, right?
scene.adulthood.parent: He stayed.#$b#I thought he'd leave, like everyone in this town eventually does.
choice.school.question: {{child}} is old enough to join Penny's class. Should he go?
choice.dream.question: {{child}} told you what he dreams about. What did you say?
